|**Fodselsdato:**|03.03.2000|

payload.goal: Créer et intégrer complètement le nouvel employé Chloé Petit à partir de la lettre d'offre, avec département, détails d'emploi, salaire annuel, pourcentage de poste et heures de travail standard.
likely_resources: Endpoint paramètres d'heures de travail standard
success_checks: L'employé Chloé Petit est créé avec la date de naissance 2000-03-03.
Le département Produksjon existe et est attribué à l'employé.
La date de début d'emploi est enregistrée au 2026-06-10.
Le type d'emploi est enregistré comme permanent/Fast stilling.
Le pourcentage de poste est défini à 100.0%.
Le salaire annuel est défini à 600000 NOK.
Les heures de travail standard sont configurées à 7.5 heures par jour.
risk_notes: Aucun email, téléphone ou adresse n'est fourni pour l'employé.
Le numéro d'organisation de l'entreprise n'est pas fourni; certaines configurations RH/paie peuvent en dépendre.
Le nom du manager n'est pas indiqué.
Le département Produksjon doit être créé d'abord dans un sandbox vide.
La configuration exacte des détails d'emploi peut dépendre des champs/API disponibles pour type d'emploi, salaire et temps de travail.
ordered_steps: Create employee record for 'Chloé Petit' with dateOfBirth=2000-03-03 and job title 'Markedsanalytiker' via employee endpoint.
Update/assign employee department to 'Produksjon' via employee or employment-details endpoint.
Configure employment details: startDate=2026-06-10, employmentType='Fast stilling', employmentPercentage=100.0, annualSalary=600000.
Configure standard working time to 7.5 hours per day via employee working-hours settings endpoint.
Verify employee profile contains department, employment percentage, annual salary, and working hours as specified in the offer letter.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find employees corresponding with sent data.

rules: ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'STANDARD' unless admin is explicitly requested.

payload.headline: Rate limit cut off execution mid-task; employment details and working hours not fully configured
what_went_wrong: LLM rate limit (429) hit after POST /employee/employment/details, halting execution before working hours and salary could be verified/completed.
POST /employee/employment/details used 'salary' field which may not be the correct field name for annualSalary; checks 5-8 and 10 failed suggesting salary/details misconfiguration.
Two failed POST /employee attempts (with userType=STANDARD and without userType) wasted tokens and time, contributing to hitting the rate limit.
Standard working hours (7.5h/day) were never configured — no call to /employee/standardTime or equivalent endpoint was made before cutoff.
what_worked: Department 'Produksjon' created successfully and employee Chloé Petit created with correct department assignment.
Employment record created with correct startDate, employmentType, remunerationType, workingHoursScheme, and employmentPercentage=100.0.
what_to_try_next: Start with userType=NO_ACCESS immediately (skip STANDARD attempt) to avoid wasted calls and token burn before hitting rate limits.
After creating employment, call POST /employee/employment/details with 'annualSalary' (not 'salary') and then POST /employee/standardTime with hoursPerDay=7.5 before any other calls.
Reduce parallel/exploratory GET calls (employmentType, remunerationType, workingHoursScheme) by caching known IDs from prior runs to stay under token rate limits.
unnecessary_calls: POST /employee with userType=STANDARD — known to fail without email; should go straight to NO_ACCESS
POST /employee without userType — also fails; second wasted attempt before correct NO_ACCESS call
GET /employee/employment/remunerationType and GET /employee/employment/workingHoursScheme — IDs (100, 50) could be hardcoded from known schema
